title: Commitment Reduction in Reviewed Escalations — Contract Pricing Agreement
content:
Commitment reduction on a reviewed escalation — Contract Pricing Agreement

The commitment reduction follows the merchandise invoiced on the customer's Commercial Credit Account less than 12 whole months before the handling date (the merchandise amount of the invoices posted there, by invoice date), divided by the agreement's annual spend commitment. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

| Invoiced merchandise over the annual commitment | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 1.5 or more | 0.5 percentage point |
| At least 1 and below 1.5 | 0.25 percentage point |
| Below 1, or an agreement with no commitment | Nothing taken off |

The points are taken off the reviewed escalation allowance — the lesser of the reviewed escalation increase and the tier's annual escalation cap — before the escalation line's prior unit price is raised by it, and the allowance never falls below 0.

Hypothetical example: 330000.00 of invoiced merchandise against a commitment of 250000.00 is 1.32 times the commitment and takes 0.25 point off.
